patch_description: This redesigns the ANSATZ_SPEC to introduce a CRX ring entangling layer and a centralized hub entanglement using CRZ/CRX with a single shared parameter. It preserves symmetry-based parameter sharing for pre/post RZ and RY layers while replacing the ring with CRX gates (shared angle crx_ring) and a unified hub_angle across hub connections. This increases expressivity at a controlled parameter budget (11 unique parameters per block instead of 10) and maintains adjacency constraints. The overall aim is to improve validation/test accuracy and reduce overfitting by leveraging ring-based entanglement and hub coupling with symmetry, without changing the fixed training loop, data construction, or feature map.
